title: How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank

nodes.title: Why Convert Your Salary Account?
nodes.summary: Salary accounts serve employees with job benefits but may be automatically converted to savings accounts if salary credits stop for 3+ months. Manual conversion avoids service interruptions, and savings accounts carry different features plus minimum balance requirements.

nodes.title: Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account
nodes.summary: Five-step branch process: visit home branch with ID, fill the Salary to Savings Account Conversion Form, submit for verification, maintain the savings minimum balance, and receive SMS/email confirmation.

children.title: 1. Visit Your Home Branch
children.summary: Locate your nearest ZX Bank branch, ideally where the salary account was opened, and carry valid proof of identity (Aadhaar, PAN Card, Passport) plus the account passbook or debit card.

children.title: 2. Fill Out the Account Conversion Request Form
children.summary: Request the Salary to Savings Account Conversion Form at the branch, enter account details, select 'Convert to Savings Account', and attach self-attested copies of KYC documents if required.

children.title: 3. Submit the Form and Documents
children.summary: Hand the completed form and documents to branch staff, who verify them and initiate the conversion process.

children.title: 4. Maintain Minimum Balance
children.summary: Maintain the required minimum balance for Savings Accounts per ZX Bank guidelines to avoid charges.

children.title: 5. Get Confirmation
children.summary: Once conversion completes you receive confirmation via SMS/email; your existing debit card, chequebook, and account number typically remain unchanged.

nodes.title: Alternative: Conversion via Digital Banking
nodes.summary: ZX Bank supports digital requests: open the ZX Bank Asia app or NetBanking, go to Service Requests > Convert Salary Account to Savings Account, fill details and upload KYC docs if asked, then receive confirmation.

nodes.title: Need Help?
nodes.summary: Help is available via ZX Bank customer care or branch locations (links provided) and the 'Zia' AI chatbot in the ZX Bank Asia app. If conversion lapses and no salary credits occur, the bank may auto-convert the account per policy.
